measurement.name: Deep Western Boundary Current
measurement.range_interpretation: Approximate width of the historical upper-core float composite. Repeated 100 km subset entries do not establish constant width, annual extrema or numerical width uncertainty.
measurement.geographic_scope: Tropical western Atlantic upper-core DWBC; Table 2 selection domain 2 S-12 N west of 43 W; section 3.2 labels a 0-7 N / 12-month composite. Source domains retained without forced equivalence.
measurement.section_orientation: Distance seaward of 1800 m isobath; velocity rotated parallel and normal to that contour.
measurement.layer: Nominal 1800 m SOFAR floats; failed active depth control and source-estimated sinking about 230 m over 21 months. No fixed numerical width layer.
measurement.time_convention: Table 2 historical composite label January 1989-October 1990, overlapping three unequal subsets. No exact width observation dates or recurring seasonal calendar extracted.
measurement.boundary_rule: Width between zero-velocity points in the composite along-boundary velocity profile, flanked by weak counterflow/recirculation; 10 km averaging bins do not supply a width error.
measurement.source_citation: Richardson, P. L. and Schmitz, W. J., Jr. (1993), Deep Cross-Equatorial Flow in the Atlantic Measured With SOFAR Floats, Journal of Geophysical Research 98(C5), 8371-8387, doi:10.1029/93JC00051.
measurement.source_locator: Final original PDF p5 / printed p8375, section 3.2 continuation; Table 2 PDF p8 / p8378; nominal depth and processing p2; subset sampling p6 and Figure 6 p7.
measurement.extraction_method: Visually reviewed numerical passage, Table 2 and methods transcribed; no plot-edge digitization or raw velocity recalculation.
measurement.source_quality_note: Composite and subset sampling are sparse and nonuniform. Nominal float depths drifted. Source-label and count inconsistencies are preserved; velocity/transport standard errors are not width errors.
remaining_gates: Acquire and reprocess raw calibrated float records with their changing depths.
Recover geographically supported zero-velocity edges before footprints or physical state intersections.
Repeated compatible sections and width errors before annual margins or seasonal playback.
measurement.width_metric_label: Zero-velocity width of along-isobath float composite

source_table_rows.sampling_qualification: Table 2 footnote: first subset sampled DWBC January-March 1989, with an offshore data gap between 90 and 130 km; transport may be underestimated and width/transport could be larger. Gap endpoints are not current edges or a width range.

original_regional_context.source_table_locator: Table 2, original PDF p8 / printed p8378
original_regional_context.source_scope_discrepancy_note: Table 2 labels 2 S-12 N west of 43 W; section 3.2 describes 0-7 N and 12 months. Historical composite period labels remain source-specific.
original_regional_context.subset_count_discrepancy_note: Published subset observation counts 124+188+177 total 489, not composite 500. No adjustment or missing-record explanation inferred.
original_regional_context.source_sampling_gap_label: No floats drifted in the boundary current April-December 1989 (Figure 4 caption).
original_regional_context.volume_transport_support_note: Total transport couples float horizontal profile with an independent current-meter profile, assumes elliptical shape and integrates 900-2800 m. These are transport construction bounds, not the width layer.
original_regional_context.display_aria_label: Deep Western Boundary Current upper-core float composite: approximately 100 kilometres between zero-velocity points. Nominal drifting 1800 m floats, nonuniform historical samples; width uncertainty unknown.
original_regional_context.display_caption: Approximately 100 km source composite width. All four Table 2 rows repeat 100 km; no independent temporal edge series, annual margins or width error supplied.
original_regional_context.display_method_note: Along-isobath velocity averaging in 10 km bins. Nominal float depth is not a fixed layer. Historical subset speeds and transport have their own standard errors; those do not measure width uncertainty.
original_regional_context.first_subset_sampling_qualification: Table 2 footnote: first subset sampled DWBC January-March 1989, with an offshore data gap between 90 and 130 km; transport may be underestimated and width/transport could be larger. Gap endpoints are not current edges or a width range.
